title: PMS2 amplification contributes to brain metastasis from lung cancer
author: Chen, Hu, et al.
materials: DNA extraction, library construction, and targeted sequencing with a commercial panel of the 168-gene panel (Burning Rock Biotech, Guangzhou, China) followed with routine processing described in previous studies [9, 27]. In brief, cfDNA was recovered from 5 ml of CSF or plasma using the QIAamp Circulating Nucleic Acid kit by Qiagen (Valencia, California, US). The Qubit 2.0 Fluorimeter (Carlsbad, California, US) was used to assess the Quantification of cfDNA. At least 50 ng of cfDNA is required to construct NGS library. Fragments between 200 and 400 bp from the sheared cfDNA were selected using Agencourt AMPure beads (Beckman Coulter, California, US), then hybridized with capture probes baits. PCR amplification was performed after hybridization selection with magnetic beads. Target capture was performed using a 168-gene targeted panel. A bioanalyzer high-sensitivity DNA kit was used to assess the quality and size of the fragments. Indexed samples were sequenced on the Nextseq 500 sequencer (Illumina, Inc., California, US) with pair-end reads.

Seven human lung cancer cell lines, namely H1299, A549, H1650, HCC827, H3255, H1975, and PC-9, along with the human bronchial epithelial cell line BEAS-2B and the Lewis lung carcinoma cell line, were obtained from the American Type Culture Collection (ATCC). These cell lines were cultured in either Roswell Park Memorial Institute (RPMI) 1640 medium (Biosharp, China) or Dulbecco's Modified Eagle Medium (DMEM) (Biosharp, China), both supplemented with 10% fetal bovine serum (FBS, Pricella, China) and 100 U/ml of a streptomycin/penicillin combination (Gibco; Thermo Fisher Scientific, Inc.). The cultures were maintained in a humidified atmosphere containing 5% CO2 at 37 °C.

Total RNA extraction was conducted using TRIzol reagent. Subsequently, cDNA was synthesized utilizing the PrimeScript™ RT Master Mix cDNA Synthesis Kit (RR360A, TaKaRa, China), following the manufacturer’s protocol. Real-time PCR was performed with TB Green qPCR Master Mix (RR820A, Takara, China) on the QuantStudio 6 Flex Real-Time PCR System (Thermo Fisher Scientific, Waltham, MA, USA). For normalization, relative mRNA levels were assessed based on the expression of GADPH. The expression values were analyzed using the 2 − ΔΔCt method, a widely accepted relative quantitative approach in real-time PCR studies. The primer sequences used were as follows: PMS2 forward: 5′- CTGGATGCTGGTCCACTAA-3′, reverse: 5′- TGTGTGATGTTTCAGAGTTAAGCC-3′; GAPDH forward: 5′- ACAACTTTGGTATCGTGGAAGG -3′, reverse: 5′- GCCATCACGCCACAGTTTC -3′.

Cells were lysed by cold RIPA Lysis Buffer (EpiZyme, China) supplemented with protease inhibitor on ice. Samples were boiled with SDS/PAGE sample buffer for 10 min and then were separated on SDS-PAGE. Post transferring, PVDF membranes (Millipore) were blocked by 5% non-fat milk TBST buffer, followed by incubation with primary antibodies at 4 °C overnight. After incubation with horseradish-peroxidase-coupled secondary antibodies at room temperature for 2 h, immunoreactive bands were visualized using ECL kit (EpiZyme, China). Anti-PMS2 antibody (A4577) and anti-GAPDH (AC001) were purchased from ABclonal Technology Co., Ltd.

steps.title: Collect CSF and plasma samples
steps.instruction: Obtain 5 ml of cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) and paired plasma from each of the 114 lung adenocarcinoma patients with brain metastasis for downstream cfDNA extraction and targeted sequencing.

steps.title: Extract and quantify cfDNA
steps.instruction: Recover circulating cfDNA from the 5 ml CSF or plasma using the QIAamp Circulating Nucleic Acid kit (Qiagen, Valencia, CA, USA); quantify cfDNA with a Qubit 2.0 Fluorometer and ensure at least 50 ng is obtained for library construction.

steps.title: Prepare NGS library and capture targets
steps.instruction: Shear cfDNA, select fragments 200–400 bp with Agencourt AMPure beads (Beckman Coulter, CA, USA), hybridize to capture probes of the 168‑gene panel (Burning Rock Biotech, Guangzhou, China), perform PCR amplification after magnetic‑bead selection, and complete target capture using the same 168‑gene panel.

steps.title: Assess library quality and sequence
steps.instruction: Evaluate fragment size and quality with a Bioanalyzer High‑Sensitivity DNA kit, index the libraries, and sequence on an Illumina NextSeq 500 (paired‑end reads) according to the manufacturer’s protocol.

steps.title: Culture lung and control cell lines
steps.instruction: Maintain H1299, A549, H1650, HCC827, H3255, H1975, PC‑9, BEAS‑2B, and Lewis lung carcinoma cells in RPMI‑1640 or DMEM (Biosharp, China) supplemented with 10 % fetal bovine serum (Pricella, China) and 100 U/ml streptomycin/penicillin (Gibco, Thermo Fisher), in a humidified 5 % CO₂ incubator at 37 °C.

steps.title: Generate lentivirus and transduce cells
steps.instruction: Produce lentivirus overexpressing PMS2 using pcSLenti‑EF1‑EGFP‑P2A‑Puro‑CMV‑MCS‑3xFLAG‑WPRE (OBIO Technology, Shanghai) and a control LV‑control using the empty vector pcSLenti‑EF1‑EGFP‑P2A‑Puro‑CMV‑PMS2‑3xFLAG‑WPRE; also generate a luciferase‑expressing virus with pSLenti‑EF1‑Luc2‑P2A‑BSR‑CMV‑MCS‑WPRE. Transduce target cells according to the manufacturer’s instructions using polybrene as the transduction agent.

steps.title: Extract RNA and synthesize cDNA
steps.instruction: Lyse cells in TRIzol reagent, isolate total RNA, and reverse‑transcribe 1 µg RNA using PrimeScript™ RT Master Mix Kit (RR360A, TaKaRa, China) following the kit protocol.

steps.title: Perform quantitative real‑time PCR
steps.instruction: Set up qPCR reactions with TB Green qPCR Master Mix (RR820A, Takara, China) on a QuantStudio 6 Flex (Thermo Fisher, Waltham, MA, USA) using GAPDH as the reference gene; analyze relative expression by the 2⁻ΔΔCt method. Primer sequences: PMS2 forward 5′‑CTGGATGCTGGTCCACTAA‑3′, reverse 5′‑TGTGTGATGTTTCAGAGTTAAGCC‑3′; GAPDH forward 5′‑ACAACTTTGGTATCGTGGAAGG‑3′, reverse 5′‑GCCATCACGCCACAGTTTC‑3′.

steps.title: Lyse cells and run western blot
steps.instruction: Lyse cells on ice with cold RIPA buffer (EpiZyme, China) plus protease inhibitor; boil lysates with SDS/PAGE sample buffer for 10 min, separate proteins by SDS‑PAGE, transfer to PVDF membranes (Millipore), block with 5 % non‑fat milk in TBST, incubate with primary antibodies (anti‑PMS2 A4577, anti‑GAPDH AC001, ABclonal) at 4 °C overnight, then with HRP‑conjugated secondary antibodies at room temperature for 2 h; detect bands using ECL kit (EpiZyme, China).

steps.title: Map DNA reads and call variants
steps.instruction: Align DNA‑seq reads to the hg19 human reference genome using BWA v0.7.10, then perform local realignment, variant calling and annotation with GATK 3.2, MuTect, and VarScan as described in the referenced study.

steps.title: Process RNA‑seq data and identify DEGs
steps.instruction: Sequence libraries on an Illumina NovaSeq 6000 (150 bp paired‑end); trim and filter raw fastq files with fastp, map clean reads to the reference genome using HISAT2, compute gene FPKM and read counts with HTSeq‑count, conduct PCA to assess sample replication, perform differential expression analysis with DESeq2 (threshold Q value ≤ 0.05 or fold‑change < 0.5), and run KEGG pathway enrichment via hypergeometric test.

steps.title: Conduct statistical analyses
steps.instruction: Compare group proportions with Fisher’s exact test, evaluate overall survival using Kaplan–Meier curves and log‑rank test, and perform all analyses and plotting in R v4.2.3; consider two‑sided p < 0.05 as statistically significant.
